decisions.question: SPEC 0296 (PAR-A01, live session event stream in the API), reviewed three times by Claude 07 and cleared for your decision (R3, sha 5fa2618e…). Recommended: D1 SSE (one-way); D2 no token deltas for now (own card later); D3 frames show an allow-listed projection per field, deny by default, no message text in v1; D4 re-read one page of 10 with backoff and jitter behind a dedicated semaphore and pool, with a numeric trigger for moving to a shared reader or LISTEN/NOTIFY; D5 a cursor beyond the end returns 409; D6 one store per request (no tenant limit); D7 missing composition = same 404 as an unknown route; D8 reuse the conversation-read permission for envelopes (message text only when a content permission exists); D9 the budget table as initial values, measured in slice 3; D10 slices 0 (extract session revalidation) → 1 → 2 → 3, client/SDK out; D11 temporary refusals are sent in-band (200 + retry + end) so the browser's native EventSource keeps reconnecting. Approve as recommended?
